ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 14-F in the area bound by:

West 58th Sireet; South Lowe Avenue; a line 222.5 feet south of and parallel to West
58th Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Lowe Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

hanie D. Coleman
rman, 16" Ward

Common Address:
5800-5816 S. Lowe Avenue
